name: Glow-Worm Caves Tamborine Mountain
reason: Rule 1 and 2: Wikivoyage Tamborine Mountain lists Tamborine Mountain Glow Worm Caves (Cedar Creek Estate, Hartley Rd) under See with a presentation cave and tunnelled chambers; open daily.
objection: It is an artificial cave on a winery estate, and the Wikivoyage listing is its only counted source; a similar guided glow-worm experience exists in Springbrook's natural bridge.

name: Gold Coast City Art Gallery
reason: Rule 1 and 2: the public gallery (now branded HOTA Gallery) is a visitor-facing museum with collection and exhibitions on hota.com.au; a museum a visitor can spend an hour in.
objection: Wikipedia names it under the old title and a source naming it as such is not counted; it may duplicate a HOTA spot if the app lists the precinct, so name it HOTA Gallery or merge when placed.

name: Gold Coast Coastal Cycle Route
reason: Rule 3: a linear transport path (the Gold Coast Oceanway Wikivoyage mentions is the same thing), no single place to visit; no coordinates.
objection: The Oceanway is a pleasant beachside walk/cycle named in Wikivoyage, but it is a route with no destination, not a spot.

name: Gold Coast Hinterland Great Walk
reason: Rule 1 and 2: a multi-day walk (Wikipedia 'tourist attractions' list) across Lamington, Springbrook and Numinbah; multi-day tracks count as spots. Only Wikipedia found; no counted visitor source opened.
objection: Against: the track is a walking route in sections crossing parks the app likely lists, no coordinates, and I found no tourism/Wikivoyage page for it as one trail. For: a promoted long walk, like Hump Ridge Track.

name: Gold Coast Parklands
reason: Rule 2: a sports and events precinct (Carrara stadium area), no visitor sight; Wikipedia sports-venue list only.
objection: Hosts big events, but events are excluded by rule 4 and the venue itself is not a draw.

name: Gold Coast Regional Botanic Gardens
reason: Rule 1 and 2: free botanic gardens at Benowa on Wikipedia's Gold Coast tourist-attractions list; a half-hour or more walk. No counted visitor page found (council and tourism URLs returned 404).
objection: For: a real garden with Wikipedia tourist-attraction listing. Against: only one non-counted source, a local park-like garden amid a coast full of bigger draws.

name: Gold Coast Turf Club
reason: Rule 2 and 4: a race-day venue, not a place to visit on arrival; Wikipedia sports list only.
objection: A racecourse can be a day out, but only on race days (rule 4).

name: H2 Hinde Tree
reason: Rule 3: a single heritage-listed tree (surveyor's marker) with no visitor source; minor marker.
objection: On Wikipedia's tourist-attractions list, but a ten-minute roadside look at most.

name: Illuminate Light & Laser Spectacular
reason: Rule 3: part of a larger spot (an attraction inside a theme park the app can list as one place). Dreamworld is the place; this is an event, kids' area or ride inside it (Illuminate is also a seasonal show, rule 4).
objection: None strong; it only exists inside the Dreamworld gate.

name: Jebribillum Bora Park
reason: Rule 1 and 2: Aboriginal bora ground at Burleigh/Currumbin Creek on the Gold Coast heritage register; open parkland, culturally significant. Only Wikipedia, no counted visitor source found.
objection: For: Indigenous ceremonial site open to the public. Against: a small park, heritage register alone does not count, short visit.

name: Kennyland
reason: Rule 3: part of a larger spot (an attraction inside a theme park the app can list as one place). Dreamworld is the place; this is an event, kids' area or ride inside it (Illuminate is also a seasonal show, rule 4).

name: Kombumerri Park

objection: The Gold Coast is one continuous beach, so it is close to a near-duplicate of Surfers Paradise and Mermaid Beach; kept as the named Broadbeach beach.

name: Lahey's Canungra Sawmill
reason: Rule 2: the old sawmill site; Wikipedia-only, no public visitor facility found.
objection: Heritage-listed, but nothing to do on site; Lahey's Tramway is the visitable piece.

name: Lahey's Canungra Tramway Tunnel

name: Laheys Tramway

objection: For: unusual heritage feature to walk. Against: one non-counted source, short visit, I could not confirm public access conditions.

name: Lions Road

name: Little Nerang Dam

name: Maroon Dam
